periods.time: Final stage of Ikki's approach to Vermillion castle

name.zh: 一辉突破亲卫队并击败丹达利昂
name.en: Ikki Defeats the Royal Guard and Dandalion

periods.location: Bridge to Vermillion noble district and church roof near the castle wall
periods.summary: Ikki reaches the only remaining bridge to the royal district and confronts the fanatical royal guard. Their sheer devotion lets them resist Phantom Form, but Ikki discovers they possess secret photos of Stella and annihilates them in fury. He then chooses a route avoiding the gathered citizens and is intercepted by Daniel Dandalion, whose Blood Circle forces a one-on-one duel. After struggling against Dandalion's flexible rapier and anti-Saigeki counters, Ikki wins by throwing Intetsu on its wrapping cord and cutting him down.
periods.cause: Sirius's final line of defense uses the royal guard and Dandalion to keep Ikki from entering the castle.
periods.process: The royal guard interrogates Ikki about living with and kissing Stella, collapses from jealousy, then attacks. Ikki's Phantom Form fails to stop their willpower, but after finding their illicit Stella photo he beats them decisively. At the castle wall, Dandalion traps Ikki in Blood Circle, uses Lionheart and Croix du Sud to wound him, and reads Saigeki. Ikki turns the predicted attack into a thrown-sword feint and reels Intetsu back for the winning strike.
periods.outcome: Dandalion concedes and entrusts Stella to Ikki; Ikki climbs the castle wall and enters the castle through Lunaeyes's room.
periods.significance: Completes Ikki's physical trial to reach Stella and wins the approval of a key Vermillion guardian.
